question: Which countries hosted the matches played in the 2021 ICC Men's T20 World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Arab Emirates and Oman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2021 ICC Men's T20 World Cup**

 
 
• Australia is the winner of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2021.
 
• The T20 World Cup 2021 was started on 17th October in UAE and Oman.
 
• The final match was played between Australia and New Zealand.
 
• That was the first time when the Australian cricket team won the T20 World Cup 2021.
 
• Australian cricketer Mitchell Marsh was the player of the match in the T20 World Cup 2021.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ICC headquarter is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
 
• It was established in 1909 by the representatives of Australia, England, and South Africa as Imperial Cricket Conference.
 
• The ICC is the global governing body for cricket which is also responsible for all ICC events.
